theorem QOU.Archimedean.SchurWeylTrace.markov_gam_pow_explicit {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq1 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hqn : QIntNonzero q (n + 1)) {B : Type u_2} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] {N : ℕ} {s : ℕ → B} (hs : IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.HeckeFamily N (q - q⁻¹) 1 s) (tr : B →ₗ[R] R) (ht1 : tr 1 = 1) (hcyc : ∀ (x y : B), tr (x * y) = tr (y * x)) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), tr (x * s k) = IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.zD q * tr x) (hn : n ≤ N) (p : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.Archimedean.SchurWeylTrace.markov_fullTwist {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq1 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hqn : QIntNonzero q (n + 1)) {B : Type u_2} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] {N : ℕ} {s : ℕ → B} (hs : IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.HeckeFamily N (q - q⁻¹) 1 s) (tr : B →ₗ[R] R) (ht1 : tr 1 = 1) (hcyc : ∀ (x y : B), tr (x * y) = tr (y * x)) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), tr (x * s k) = IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.zD q * tr x) (hn : n ≤ N) (t : ℕ) :
